datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2012 and spatially mapped to administrative or livelihood zones in Burkina Faso. The classifications represent food insecurity severity phases (IPC 1-5) as a loss/impact metric derived from food security assessments.
